question: Who among the following had written the National anthem of Bangladesh 'Amar Sonar Bangla'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindranath Tagore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** wrote "Amar Sonar Bangla" to inspire the liberation struggle.
 
• The song was written in **1905** during the first partition of Bengal by **Lord Curzon**.
 
• This song was meant to rekindle the unified spirit of Bengal, to raise public consciousness against the communal political divide.
 
• The first ten lines of this song constitute** Bangladesh's national anthem**, adopted in **1971 **during its liberation war. 
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was a **Nobel laureate **for literature and wrote the words and music to India‘s national anthem.
